description: UC Merced — strong CA in-state applicant, RD, CS major
rationale: UCM CDS-published RD admit rate ~88%. Strong stats (1500/3.9) put applicant at/above 75th percentile (×1.3 GPA, ×1.2 test); CA in-state at UC system (×1.8). Combined ≈ 2.8× anchor; clamped to anchor × 2.5. Final probability bounded by [0.66, 0.98] but clamp ceiling 0.98 binds. Expected range [0.80, 0.92] reflects typical-strong-applicant case.
